stories.headline: Colombian Navy and US agents recover 2 tonnes of cocaine from two speedboats in the Caribbean off Cartagena
stories.summary: Colombia's Navy reported, in a joint operation with US personnel, taking 2,001 kg of cocaine hydrochloride packed in 80 sacks from two go-fast boats; one crew had thrown bundles…
